title: MITC to fund mental health support for 50 tour crews a year
summary: The Music Industry Therapist Collective (MITC) has announced a fund of $272,000 to support 50 touring teams with mental health support each year, in a scheme set to last three years. title: Estadio GNP Seguros rolls out sensory vest-led accessible area
summary: Expanding on OCESA’s sensory vest scheme, Mexico’s Estadio GNP Seguros has introduced a new accessible area in the venue, complete with vest use and sign language interpretation services.
